sections.visual_strategy: Human-scale frontier infrastructure, then two real Anthropic safety-document pages that establish the race paradox without decorative dashboards.
Official Anthropic research figures, clearly labelled fictional test context and restrained source-derived explanation between real footage breaks.
Dated Stanford investment evidence, frontier-compute context and physical competition metaphors; no stock-market interface or fabricated benchmark screen.
Claim-specific cyber and biological context, provider-attributed reporting and ASL-3 primary documents with limitations visible on screen.
Human work and information environments supported by source-derived persuasion, labour-exposure and market-concentration evidence; generic stock never carries proof.
Real EU AI Act pages for classification and duties, followed by a concise compliance-cost analysis that remains clearly labelled as inference.
Symmetrical open-versus-closed trade-off treatment with matched human and technical context; neither release model is framed as universally safe.
Independent evaluation, incident reporting, cybersecurity and structural oversight presented as a layered system rather than a single solution.
Recap only previously established evidence, then return to human decisions and institutional responsibility before a restrained branded close.
